```
kubectl -n sandbox rollout status deploy/api-gateway
kubectl -n sandbox logs deploy/api-gateway -c gateway | tail -n 50
```
jen: hold on config promotion until smoke passes for 10m, don't promote to dedicated yet
samir: noted. Will pin behavior flags off for now.
deploy-bot: Deployment finished (initial steps) in 2m 45s — canary at 5% for 10m monitor window
ci/cd-bot: Scheduled metric check (latency/error budget) in 10m

samir: I'll pin the sandbox tag as a reference: pinned -> api-gateway:v1.14.0-rc.3 (sandbox) :pushpin:
kevin: cluster alerts: increased 500s on one pod — correlating with a dependency endpoint 3rd-party-auth getting 502s
ci/cd-bot: Metric alert: error_rate(api-gateway) breached threshold in sandbox (window 5m) — 3.6% > 2% :rotating_light:
jen: seeing the same in SLO dashboard. Recommend rollback to last stable if impact persists beyond 2 more minutes
maria.ortiz: agree. Rollback to v1.13.9 (commit d4c3b2a) if no recovery in 2m.
samir: initiating rollback decision now to avoid noisy tests.
deploy-bot: Rollback started -> target tag: v1.13.9, commit: d4c3b2a. Action: rolling back deployment to previous replica set.
ci/cd-bot: Rollback pipeline triggered: rollback job id rb-20260320-78 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: Rollback completed in 1m 12s — all pods back to v1.13.9, health checks green (3/3)
kevin: confirming migration warnings cleared on v1.13.9
maria.ortiz: filed a short postmortem note in the release thread: mention degraded 3rd-party auth + migration-warning coupling.
jen: will follow up with tests to reproduce locally. For prod/dedicated we'll schedule a longer change window next week.
samir: thanks all. tagging this sandbox deploy as "rc3 -> rollback" for tracking. :white_check_mark:
maria.ortiz: :thumbsup:
